description: This file defines structures and classes related to executing hooks in the Swabble project. It includes a data structure for a hook job and an actor responsible for managing and running hook commands with timeout and environment configuration.

classes.name: HookExecutor
classes.description: An actor responsible for executing hook commands with cooldown, timeout, and environment configuration.

methods.name: shouldRun
methods.description: Determines if the hook should run based on cooldown settings.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Executes the hook command asynchronously, with timeout and environment handling.
